title: 500 Series 24" Dishwasher
sub: Stainless steel, pocket handle, top controls
lead: Bosch's 500 Series in fingerprint-resistant stainless steel, with a pocket handle and the controls set into the top edge of the door. It washes at 44 dBA, releases its own door to dry, and carries a third rack.

features.name: AutoAir
features.line: At the end of the cycle the door releases on its own. Moisture escapes, fresh air comes in, and the dishes come out drier.

features.name: Quiet at 44 dBA
features.line: Rated at 44 dBA. Run it after dinner while the conversation carries on. InfoLight shines on the floor so you know a cycle is under way.

features.name: Zone Wash
features.line: An intensive wash area for the challenging pieces. Give the roasting pan and the stockpot the spot they need.

features.name: Third rack
features.line: A third rack on top for utensils and the small pieces that crowd the racks below.

features.name: AquaStop leak protection
features.line: Bosch's leak protection is on watch around the clock, during a cycle and between them.

also: Favorite button: your usual cycle and options in one touch
Wi-Fi with Home Connect, there if you want it: more cycles and options from a phone
specs: Deep Clean, Auto, Normal, Speed60, Favorite
